Match the validator's canonical nested Union spelling for existing int-or-string pytest worker annotations; no behavioral or implementation scope change.
Extend the worker-override contract to prove multi-job verification stays on legacy coverage until contextual evidence can receive the outer command-job count, preserving the global process budget.
Correct the multi-job fallback assertion to preserve ordinary concurrent command execution: coverage runs first, while pytest and residual tests-stage commands may complete in either order.

Strengthen residual-stage proof with an active pytest manifest that has no runtime coverage targets; require exact whole-group command equality so a larger ordinary batch never reuses partial coverage execution.

Expand the contract minimally to carry the scheduling notice already produced by contextual execution through RuntimeGroupEvidence and BatchTestResult, preserving JSON/text parity without an additional collection probe; also require exact whole-group command matching and defer noncoverage pytest manifests.
Make RuntimeGroupEvidence scheduling_notice part of the behavioral fixture contract so static behavioral validation and runtime propagation both prove the typed field.
Match the scheduling-notice assertion to the runner's canonical batched pytest command ordering (targets before verbosity options).
Add the evolved runtime-evidence suite to the manifest's declared validation command so scheduling-notice propagation is part of the implementation gate.

revisions.reason: Redesign after independent review: evidence accelerates artifact coverage only; ordinary tests always run fresh to eliminate mutation, profiler-observability, timing-scheduler, and stale-result false greens.
Canonicalize the promoted manifest timestamp to its equivalent UTC representation so repository validation is warning-free; no contract, scope, or behavior change.
Fail closed when the instrumented evidence command mutates project bytes: bind coverage evidence to a pre-execution digest and add the reviewer-reproduced target-deletion adversary.
Strengthen the mutation adversary to exercise both verify orchestration and the direct evidence evaluator, proving a disappeared target cannot be padded into an empty successful report.
Extend the mutation adversary to the preparation-exception path so collection cannot alter project bytes, raise, and then obtain an empty successful legacy fallback from the altered tree.

Bound worst-case cost after the measured >61-minute fallback-heavy deep run: project-owned conftest.py selects legacy coverage before speculative contextual execution until a cheap lifecycle preflight is implemented.
